title: SpikeSTAG: A Dendritic Compartmental Spiking Graph Network for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2508.02069v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a distinctive paradigm for temporal modeling through their intrinsic membrane potential dynamics. However, existing SNN-based forecasting methods focus exclusively on temporal processing, lacking mechanisms to capture spatial dependencies among variables. To bridge this gap, we propose SpikeSTAG, a neuromorphic spatiotemporal architecture that integrates graph-based spatial reasoning into spike-driven temporal computation. Central to our approach is the Dendritic Graph Module, which reinterprets spectral graph convolutions as biological dendritic integration --- coupling multi-scale spatial aggregation with the temporal dynamics of spiking neurons within a single computational unit. translated_title: SpikeSTAG：一种用于多变量时间序列预测的树突隔室化脉冲图网络
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络凭借其内在的膜电位动力学，为时间建模提供了一种独特的范式。然而，现有的基于SNN的预测方法仅专注于时间处理，缺乏捕捉变量间空间依赖关系的机制。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了SpikeSTAG，这是一种神经形态时空架构，将基于图的空间推理融入脉冲驱动的时间计算之中。我们方法的核心是树突图模块，该模块将谱图卷积重新解释为生物学意义上的树突整合——在单一计算单元内将多尺度空间聚合与脉冲神经元的时间动力学耦合起来。为了自适应地融合由此产生的空间与时间表示，我们进一步引入了双流整合模块，该模块采用竞争门控和基于重合的放大机制，选择性地增强……
tldr: 提出SpikeSTAG神经形态架构，通过树突图模块将谱图卷积与脉冲神经元动力学在单一单元内耦合，并利用双流整合模块自适应融合空间与时间表示，从而在多变量时间序列预测中同时捕捉时空依赖关系。
en_tdlr: SpikeSTAG reinterprets spectral graph convolutions as biological dendritic integration and adaptively fuses spatial and temporal representations via competitive gating, enabling spatiotemporal dependency modeling for multivariate time-series forecasting.
